messages:
dylan: Heads up — promo to prod is blocked. deploy-bot failed at 'fetch-cache' stage with 504 from artifact-cache and subsequent smoke tests flaked. Change window in 35m.

lila: Seen it. Build 2026.03.20-rc7 artifacts partially restored, some layers returned 504s causing the container digest resolution to fallback to slower path which times out in deploy job.

rob: I pulled the deploy logs: cache client retryed then evicted lease: 
```
error: cache_fetch_timeout: key=blob:sha256:aa11... status=504 attempts=5 lease=evicted
```

deploy-bot: promote-job-782: failed_step=fetch-cache error=cache_fetch_timeout, job_state=FAILED

ci-bot: Re-ran artifact fetch in staging — succeeded when hitting origin instead of cache. artifact checksums still match: sha256:aa11... == stored. No corruption.

qa-bot: Smoke tests against the partially restored image failed on /api/health-check (timeout) and a Search tile assert. Flaky but repeatable when cache path used.

dylan: So root cause looks like a regional cache eviction causing timeouts, not artifact corruption. For the release window we have two options: (A) delay promo and wait for cache to warm (risk missing window), or (B) pin back to rc6 and continue. Thoughts?

release-mgr: If we miss the window we push the whole cut to next slot which will cascade. Recommend pin to rc6 to keep commitments and open incident for cache infra.

lila: Agree. Pin rc6. I'll run the safe-pin and abort promote job. Keep rollback minimal (no DB changes).

rob: Steps:
1) pin prod route to 2026.03.18-rc6 image: `deployctl route pin --env=prod --image=sha256:77f2... --reason="cache eviction"`
2) abort promote job: `deployctl job abort --id promote-782`
3) mark release notes: add line about pin and planned re-promote after cache fix.

deploy-bot: aborting promote-782 per request... DONE.

lila: pin complete: prod -> 2026.03.18-rc6 sha256:77f2... :white_check_mark:

ci-bot: Post-pin healthcheck: endpoints 200, p50 latency unchanged. smoke tests green against rc6.

qa-bot: Filing a regression ticket to retest rc7 once cache infra team confirms eviction rate reduced.

dylan: Thanks. Opening incident INC-2026-047 for cache evictions and will coordinate with infra. We'll schedule a controlled re-promote of rc7 after cache fix and validation. For now release window preserved. :thumbsup:
